request.request_id: optional uint32 decimal; zero is manual and is not replayed

move.coordinates: absolute S3519 output-shaft angle relative to this power-on zero
move.mapping: motor, position, and speed lists have equal nonzero length and map by list order; no broadcasting
move.numbers: plain decimal normal IEEE-754 float32 values; position may also be zero and speed must be greater than zero
move.numeric_syntax: optional leading plus or minus, digits with at most one decimal point, at least one digit, and no exponent
move.position_limit: abs(position_deg) <= discovered PMAX converted to degrees
move.speed_limit: speed_deg_s <= min(discovered VMAX, discovered MAX_SPD) converted to degrees per second
move.boundary_policy: equal is accepted; over-limit values are rejected without clamping
move.host_submission: send exactly once and wait for matching ok and done; no ping keepalive
move.completion_gate: fresh disabled feedback for every selected motor

jog.limits: the same discovered PMAX, VMAX, and MAX_SPD runtime admission rules
jog.keepalive: ping about every 250 ms while energized or moving

lifecycle.watchdog_scope: any motor enabled or motion active, except an accepted self-contained bench move while it owns discovery-through-disable cleanup

show_motor_move_fields.pmax_deg: discovered PMAX in output-shaft degrees, or ? when unavailable
show_motor_move_fields.vmax_deg_s: discovered VMAX in output-shaft degrees per second, or ? when unavailable
show_motor_move_fields.max_speed_deg_s: discovered MAX_SPD in output-shaft degrees per second, or ? when unavailable
show_motor_move_fields.move_speed_limit_deg_s: min(VMAX, MAX_SPD) in output-shaft degrees per second, or ? when unavailable
show_motor_move_fields.format: compact three-decimal formatting; for example 20 rad/s is 1145.916 deg/s

bench_move_results.completed: done <id> bench move result=completed elapsed_ms=<uint32> motors=<two-digit-hex-mask>
bench_move_results.failed: done <id> bench move result=failed stage=<stage> code=<code> motor=<1..7|?>
bench_move_results.failed_motor: one-based selected motor when attributable, otherwise ?
bench_move_results.motors_mask: selected motor bit mask; motor 1 is bit 0

request_arbitration.active_action: a second ordinary command returns code=busy without replacing the active move
request_arbitration.stop: bench stop may preempt an active move; the original move ends as cancelled and stop has its own terminal result
request_arbitration.replay: an identical nonzero request ID and normalized body replays its recent result without moving again
request_arbitration.conflict: the same nonzero request ID with a different normalized body returns code=request_conflict

legacy.status: retained for regression only; not used by the firmware application entry
